segments.thag5.2:2.1: “Abbūḷhaṃ aghagataṃ vijitaṃ, ekañce ossajeyya kalīva siyā;
segments.thag5.2:2.3: Sabbānipi ce ossajeyya andhova siyā, samavisamassa adassanato.
segments.thag5.2:3.1: “Yañhi kayirā tañhi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade;
segments.thag5.2:4.1: [dha. pa.51 dhammapadepi]“Yathāpi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ agandhakaṃ;
segments.thag5.2:4.3: Evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, aphalā hoti akubbato.
segments.thag5.2:5.1: [dha. pa.52]“Yathāpi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ sugandhakaṃ [sagandhakaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.thag5.2:5.3: Evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, saphalā hoti kubbato”ti [sakubbato (sī. pī.), sukubbato (syā.)].
